title: SPECIAL DRIVE FOR THE EXPEDITIOUS DISPOSAL OF LONG-PENDING LABOUR CASES
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Labour & Employment

SPECIAL DRIVE FOR THE EXPEDITIOUS DISPOSAL OF LONG-PENDING LABOUR CASES

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
27 JUL 2026 4:40PM by PIB Delhi

The Office of the Chief Labour Commissioner (Central) has launched a three-month Special Drive from 1
st
 June, 2026 to 31
st
 August, 2026 for the expeditious disposal of pending industrial dispute cases and claim cases relating to wages, gratuity, maternity benefits and other statutory claims.

As on 1
st
 June, 2026 a total of 16,033 cases were pending before the field offices. During the first month of the Special Drive, 2,769 cases have been disposed of.

This information was given by the Union Minister of State for Labour & Employment, Sushri Shobha Karandlaje in a written reply in Lok Sabha today.

*****

Rini Choudhury/Anjelina Alexander

(रिलीज़ आईडी: 2289942)
